title: Single-binary package registry proxy that enforces dependency cooldowns at the network layer
user: Platform/security engineer at a 5-200 person team who must guarantee that no npm, PyPI, or crates package younger than N days reaches a developer machine or CI runner.
smallest_useful_product: A static Rust binary exposing npm registry, PyPI simple-index, and Cargo sparse-index endpoints; caching artifacts, applying cooldown and expiring exclusions, blocking advisory-listed versions, and writing a refusal audit log.
